issues_without_maintainer_response.title: Low-level Server support for mcp dev and mcp run command
Option to not rewrite the logging configuration
STDIO hangs forever when the  using multiprocessing in tools
Enable FastMCP to filter tools, prompts, resources using a fine grained policy
Don’t use shell=True in mcp dev subprocess on Windows (command injection risk)
Protected Resource Metadata resource erroneous when setting up authentication on server
Trailing slash in `.well-known/oauth-protected-resource` response may violate “Canonical Server URI” requirement
Server hangs when shutting down if a connection is still open
401 in Streamable HTTP should be handled gracefully
OAuth TokenHandler should check Authorization header for client credentials
Critical Token Refresh Bugs - Prevents Proactive Refresh
Clients Using Storage Face Deadlock on Token Refresh for SSE
`stdio_server` uses unbuffered memory streams which can cause server to block and become unresponsive
Using /.well-known/ OAuth endpoints behind custom path on GKE
Lazy HTTP connections seem to make error handling difficult.
It is not possible to define a Resource that takes only the Context parameter as an argument.
OAuthClientProvider._handle_token_response expect json
Client tool call hangs forever if server crashes or connection dies when using streamable-http
ClientDisconnect returns HTTP 500
FastMCP configures logging on init, which messes up application-level logging
User-Agent header in sHTTP transport is not forwarded to auth flow
Streamable HTTP transport drops requests immediately after `initialize`
Document and provide hooks for sandboxing file and network access in MCP tools
Refactor func_metadata() into smaller components for schema & metadata generation
`auth` specification in `ClientSessionGroup`
More control over stderr in stdio client
client's `read_stream_writer` open after SSE disconnection hanging `.receive()`
ClientAuthenticator ignores token_endpoint_auth_method="none" when client_secret is stored
Bug: String parameters starting with digits coerced to numbers, causing UUID data loss
Using transport="stdio" closes real stdio, causing ValueError after server exits
Support MCP client session resumption (sessionId reuse) in Python SDK
Allow `OAuthClientProvider` to accept a pre-configured auth server URL
Add wildcard pattern support for `allowed_hosts` in transport security
Active Streamable HTTP sessions are not terminated during shutdown
Bug: validate_scope rejects client scopes when required scopes in None
pywin32 installation fails on Windows — hard dep only needed for client stdio, but pulled in for all users via eager import in __init__.py
Don't override client_metadata.scopes if they are already set
Improve log clarity for "Terminating session: None" in stateless mode
ClientSession: add public API for updating callbacks after initialization
StreamableHTTP client: _handle_reconnection resets attempt counter to 0, causing infinite retry loop
Bug: AssertionError: Request already responded to — cancellation race in v1.27.0
McpError is not pickle-safe and fails to unpickle
Windows: TextIOWrapper in stdio_server() emits CRLF instead of LF, corrupting newline-delimited JSON messages
[v1.x] Server-side outputSchema validation blocks tool error reporting (isError: true)
Initialize call hangs forever if MCP server does not return a `Content-Type: text/plain`
session_idle_timeout is not exposed via streamable_http_app() and can cancel active requests
stdio_client crashes on malformed UTF-8 from child stdout instead of surfacing parse error
Return 405 on GET when stateless_http=True
MCPServer unconditionally declares `prompts`, `resources`, `tools` capabilities on `initialize`
raise without from discards exception chain in 12 remaining sites
OAuth token refresh sends RFC 8707 resource parameter that Entra ID v2.0 rejects (AADSTS9010010)
Expose `schema_generator` on `FastMCP` for tool params schema generation
`ClientConfig` has inconsistent naming: `message_handler` should be `message_callback`
Duplicate `initialize` with changed parameters can overwrite `ServerSession.client_params`
RequestResponder.__exit__ leaks CancelledError on cancelled request, killing the stdio receive loop
Add option to skip output validation for mcp client
DCR registration accepts redirect_uris with non-HTTPS / non-loopback / fragmented schemes
mcp.server.fastmcp.FastMCP HTTP transport deadlocks after ~5 sequential client sessions on Windows (companion to PrefectHQ/fastmcp#4192)
FastMCP.run(transport="stdio") produces noisy traceback on KeyboardInterrupt instead of clean exit
Streamable HTTP server silently drops in-flight request when client reuses a JSON-RPC id
ClientSession receive loop swallows callback exceptions, replying "Invalid request parameters" to the server instead of propagating to the call_tool awaiter
FastMCP/stdio: in-flight tool responses dropped on stdin EOF when input is bash-redirected from a file
`OAuthClientInformationFull.redirect_uris`: pydantic strict-type-equality breaks `AnyUrl(x) != AnyHttpUrl(x)` round-trip
`ClientSessionGroup` attempts to use capabilities that were not advertised
streamable_http client does not send `Origin` header → rejected with 403 by spec-compliant servers (e.g. go-sdk `CrossOriginProtection`)
Stateful Streamable HTTP: in-session exceptions are masked as an empty -32603; real cause only in a separate "Session crashed" log
Deep JSON-RPC request over stdio logs a validation error and leaves the original request pending
OAuth handler doesn't support redirect URLs with params
`simple-auth` is not working as expected
Invalid JSON-RPC envelope errors are not correlated with the original request id
Bug: anyio.Lock in async_auth_flow causes RuntimeError under concurrent OAuth MCP connections
dict[str, T] tool return types lose Annotated/Field metadata in output schema
StreamableHTTP server accumulates CLOSE_WAIT sockets behind reverse proxy due to missing disconnect cleanup
[Bug] check_capability does not validate elicitation sub-capabilities (form/url)
WWW-Authenticate parsing matches a field name as a substring of another auth-param
FuncMetadata.pre_parse_json mis-detects str | None as non-string and corrupts JSON-looking string arguments
streamable HTTP (stateful): concurrent requests with duplicate JSON-RPC ids cross-wire responses — one request receives another's payload, the other hangs
FastMCP tool argument models silently ignore unknown/misspelled arguments (extra=ignore default)
[v2] RFC 9728 PRM URLs and resource matching drop query components
Heavy sync init work (e.g. local ML models) starves stdio initialize/tool calls even with threadpool offload -- Windows GIL contention
RequireAuthMiddleware omits RFC 6750 scope in WWW-Authenticate on 401/403
Streamable HTTP server never returns the spec-mandated 405 for GET requests it won't serve as SSE (406/400 instead) — breaks client SSE-probe fallback
Generated output schema uses Pydantic's validation shape while structured output uses its serialization shape
Field alias is published in the tool schema but forwarded as an invalid Python keyword
Dispatcher mints a request id already used by a completed caller-supplied request (spec: ids MUST NOT be reused in a session)
perf: JSONRPCMessage smart union scores all four branches on every inbound message
OAuth client sends client_id in token body under client_secret_basic (strict servers reject as multiple auth methods)
Add `ClientSession.register_tool_schema()` for dynamic tool discovery patterns
Fix Streamable HTTP Accept header quality-factor handling
[v2] JSON-RPC error responses leave client OpenTelemetry spans UNSET
Bug: OAuth provider holds context.lock for the whole request, so the standalone GET SSE stream stalls the first tools/call by ~15s
Rejected streamable-HTTP requests leave live sessions behind: the session is registered before the request is validated
Client-side support for the tasks extension (io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks, SEP-2663)
Parameterized Context loses request state in resource and prompt handlers
Expose create_mcp_http_client and McpHttpClientFactory as public API (2.0 made them private-only)
OAuth token refresh hits the wrong endpoint when the auth server lives under a path
OAuth client can never recover from an expired DCR client secret — even though the SDK's own server issues and enforces one
[v2] MCPServer reports empty experimental capabilities as {} via initialize but None via server/discover
OAuthClientProvider._initialize() breaks transparent refresh: missing update_token_expiry + missing oauth_metadata load
`handle_get_stream` reconnects indefinitely when the server ends the GET stream normally (`attempt = 0` defeats `MAX_RECONNECTION_ATTEMPTS`)
Log exceptions in tool calls
Mcp-Name accepts an orphan header, while Mcp-Param-* rejects it as a routing spoof
New example: examples/servers/admission-gate — a real approve/deny ServerMiddleware demo
streamable_http (legacy mode): early response.aclose() discards a TCP connection per JSON-RPC exchange — deterministic reproduction for #2707
resource_url_from_server_url preserves explicit default ports
find_context_parameter treats a Context return annotation as a parameter
docs: clarify when Client(raise_exceptions=True) actually raises
check_resource_allowed(): path matching skips dot-segment/percent-encoding normalization (auth-boundary bypass)
Cleanly terminated streamable-HTTP sessions are never deregistered: the DELETE path skips its own cleanup
Streamable HTTP clean EOF reconnects can exceed the request retry budget
A tool returning an empty list produces a CallToolResult with zero content blocks
[v2] Expose the SSE max_event_size setting in Streamable HTTP clients
streamable-http client: no size bound before JSONRPCMessage.model_validate_json — one large server message can OOM the client
Windows MCP SSH stdio transport closes after initialize when PROGRAMDATA is missing from inherited environment
Add add_resource_template() to MCPServer
A tool returning a non-finite float fails on the client with an error naming the tool
Prompt validation errors are logged with an unnecessary traceback
Server.call_tool()'s input-validation error result discards jsonschema.ValidationError's structured fields, leaving only free-text prose
Client treats JSON-null structuredContent as missing, skipping outputSchema validation
